title: dfilter: Minor flex clean up
description:
Replace flex prefix to improve readability.

Remove two no-longer-needed workarounds to suppress warnings.

notes.body:
Getting some warnings after this change :disappointed: 

```
[13/38] Building C object epan/dfilter/CMakeFiles/dfilter.dir/scanner.c.o
epan/dfilter/scanner.c: In function ‘yy_fatal_error’:
epan/dfilter/scanner.c:3902:58: warning: unused parameter ‘yyscanner’ [-Wunused-parameter]
 static void yy_fatal_error (yyconst char* msg , yyscan_t yyscanner)
                                                          ^
epan/dfilter/scanner.c: In function ‘df_yyalloc’:
epan/dfilter/scanner.c:4248:46: warning: unused parameter ‘yyscanner’ [-Wunused-parameter]
 void *df_yyalloc (yy_size_t  size , yyscan_t yyscanner)
                                              ^
epan/dfilter/scanner.c: In function ‘df_yyrealloc’:
epan/dfilter/scanner.c:4253:61: warning: unused parameter ‘yyscanner’ [-Wunused-parameter]
 void *df_yyrealloc  (void * ptr, yy_size_t  size , yyscan_t yyscanner)
                                                             ^
epan/dfilter/scanner.c: In function ‘df_yyfree’:
epan/dfilter/scanner.c:4265:39: warning: unused parameter ‘yyscanner’ [-Wunused-parameter]
 void df_yyfree (void * ptr , yyscan_t yyscanner)
                                       ^
```
Guess the workaround is still needed :smile:

Guess so :smile:. I thought that might be the case. Thanks for letting me know.

Can you tell me how you are building so I can try to reproduce it? Which distro and flex version? And the compiler please.
Well, my IT env. hasn't got the promise upgrade yet.. so I'm stuck at RHEL7.9 with GCC4.8.5
Can you check if !9303 solves it for you?
